workItem: Extend the merged backend-first authentication architecture with Supabase email/password registration, email login, confirmation/resend, password recovery/update, and verify the canonical Website -> Supabase -> Stripe subscription identity contract without restoring browser token authority.
workItemDE: Backend-first Authentifizierung um E-Mail/Passwort-Registrierung, E-Mail-Login, Bestätigung, Passwort-Reset und den kanonischen Website-Supabase-Stripe-Abovertrag erweitern
projectStage: PVC-02 Controlled Implementation with PVC-08 production operations; FE presentation is foreign-owner handover
priorityReason: Google authentication is now productive; ordinary email registration/authentication and recovery are the next missing user-access path and must preserve the new backend session/security boundary.
scopeBoundary: Supabase Auth remains the upstream identity authority for Google and email/password accounts.
Email/password credentials are submitted only to backend auth endpoints; Supabase access/refresh tokens remain inaccessible to browser JavaScript.
Registration confirmation and password recovery use Supabase email flows and server-side token-hash verification; no access token is placed in a browser URL.
Existing on_auth_user_created -> public.handle_new_user() remains the profile/subscription initializer for every new auth.users UUID.
Paid entitlement authority remains stripe.* provider sync -> stripe_subscription_sync_trigger -> public.subscriptions keyed by validated auth.users UUID.
public.users tier/stripe columns are legacy evidence only and are not introduced as a runtime entitlement authority.
CAPITAL-AI-FE owns user-visible login/register/reset form materialization and receives an owner-correct API handover.
No provider-managed Stripe Sync Edge Function is forked or manually narrowed.
No production Supabase DDL/data mutation occurs before repository/Human gate.

evidence.mergedFoundation: PR #1270 merged backend-first Google OAuth and is user-verified productive for two Google accounts.
evidence.legacyDrift: public.users contains historical tier/stripe values and has no current repository entitlement reader; it is not canonical.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: No open PR matched registration/password/email-auth/Stripe-subscription scope at branch creation.
evidence.postMergeProductionEvidence: Email auth backend deployed through main; live legacy billing convergence completed under fresh Owner direction with 2 public.users rows aligned to canonical public.subscriptions while preserving 46 usage_log rows.

acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/register creates a Supabase email/password user after server password-safety validation and returns an enumeration-resistant confirmation-required response.
POST /api/auth/login/email establishes the same HttpOnly backend session contract as Google OAuth.
POST /api/auth/password/forgot requests a Supabase recovery email without revealing whether an email exists.
GET /api/auth/email/confirm verifies Supabase token_hash/type server-side and persists the backend session without exposing tokens to browser JavaScript.
POST /api/auth/password/update requires a verified backend session, rechecks password safety, updates the Supabase password, and persists any rotated session.
POST /api/auth/confirmation/resend sends a generic signup-confirmation resend response.
New auth users continue to receive public.profiles + Free public.subscriptions through the existing database trigger.
Stripe checkout metadata user_id/plan_id and the live stripe.subscriptions trigger stay aligned with the canonical public.subscriptions projection.
Focused and full required repository checks pass on the exact PR head.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required; FE presentation is delivered through an owner-correct handover.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession, or abandonment.
releaseReason: Human/CODEOWNER merged PR #1273 into main@eb23384dbb822d941a737d4d91b864b736166167; backend email auth/billing sync is productive. Remaining visible registration work is owner-correct CAPITAL-AI-FE scope.
